subject: Post-discovery: Procurement path & trial-to-paid gating for Orion Analytics
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@orion-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: Procurement path & trial-to-paid gating for Orion Analytics

Hi Laura — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from my side + a few questions so we can lock the commercial path and pilot gating.

Recap:
- Pilot goal: validate embedding-based similarity search across two product integrations (search UI + anomaly detection webhook).
- Performance targets discussed: p95 latency target roughly <200ms on your typical queries; token cost sensitivity flagged.
- Timeline: your team wants to start a short pilot ASAP and then confirm go/no-go for production.

Open items (need from your side):
1) Procurement route: do you expect to pay via corporate card, standard PO (Net-30), or route via a cloud marketplace (e.g., AWS Marketplace)? Which path speeds paperwork for you?
2) Trial success criteria and usage thresholds for moving to paid — can you confirm the minimum acceptance metrics (integration count, uptime/latency, usage volume) so we can set clear gates?
3) Billing start trigger: should billing begin when PO is signed, on a calendar date after the pilot, or only after the success criteria are verified?

Attachments: I’ve attached a short procurement questionnaire and a mutual action plan template to speed intake. If useful, I can circulate an SOW draft and bring Marissa in to coordinate PO/invoice details.

Proposed next step: once you confirm procurement path and success criteria, I’ll draft a MAP with milestone dates and route the SOW to Legal. Can we aim to finalize procurement route by Friday (5/21)?

Thanks — Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Laura Chen <laura@orion-analytics.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orion-analytics.com
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:06:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: Procurement path & trial-to-paid gating for Orion Analytics

Thanks Aditya — good summary. Quick answers below and I attached the completed procurement questionnaire.

1) Procurement route: We prefer a PO (Net-30) for enterprise purchases. Marketplace could be considered later, but PO is the fastest for our finance process. Procurement contact is procurement@orion-analytics.com.

2) Success criteria (pilot exit):
- Two integrations running end-to-end (search UI + anomaly webhook) with production-like traffic for two weeks.
- p95 latency < 200ms on sample traffic; acceptable error rate < 0.5%.
- Monthly token consumption during pilot should be under 5M tokens (budget check).

3) Billing start trigger: We expect billing to start once we sign the PO and the pilot metrics are validated (i.e., the two-week production-like run has met success criteria). We typically date the PO effective date to the signature date.

Timeline note: Procurement team has a standing PO approval meeting on 5/24 — if we can get the paperwork in their queue before that, we can move quickly.

Laura Chen
CTO, Orion Analytics
laura@orion-analytics.com

Perfect, thanks Laura — that's very clear and helpful. Two quick items I’ll action this afternoon:

If that sounds good I’ll send the MAP + SOW link by EOD.

Thanks — Aditya

Notes for routing to Orion procurement: 
- Use the attached SOW draft (redwood-sow-draft.docx). Keep term simple: 12-month initial term with 60-day pilot credit.
- Invoice cadence: monthly in arrears, Net-30. Finance prefers PO # on the invoice and a single line item referencing the pilot SKU + per-token addendum.
- Marketplace: mark as "not selected" for now, but include clause that allows future migration to marketplace billing.
- Legal contact (cc): sarah.kim@orion-analytics.com — she prefers DocuSign for SOW execution but will accept emailed SOW + PO for now.

I’ll prepare the invoice template and the MAP spreadsheet — will share links in the next message.
